title: The boundaries gate refuses a harness reach and a second writer, and names its exceptions
requirement: REQ-299 AC-2: the architecture-boundaries check refuses (code 1) an import of the harness internals outside the seam and a second writer of a state, while a legal tree passes with 0. AC-3: exceptions are named, each with an owner and a reason, and a stale exception is a finding of its own.
steps: Run node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs --check --json on the kit tree: exit 0, no open or stale findings, every waived exception has owner and reason.

Copy the excepted files into a fixture tree, add plugins/foreign/foreign.mjs importing @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent/lib/types.js and calling writeFileSync('taskboard.rows.json'), and run the gate with --root: exit 1 naming I-SEAM-ONLY and I-ONE-WRITER.
Run the gate with --root on a bare tree without the excepted code: exit 1 and the stale exceptions are reported.
Repeat on a tree before commit 3896ecb (no scripts/check-boundaries.mjs): the driver refuses.
expected: The kit tree passes the gate with exit 0 and no open or stale findings; every excepted finding names an owner and a reason; a tree with a harness-internals import outside the seam and a foreign board write is refused with exit 1 naming I-SEAM-ONLY and I-ONE-WRITER; a tree where the excepted code is gone is refused with a stale exception.
failsWhen: An injected harness reach or second state writer passes the gate, the legal tree is refused, an exception has no owner or reason, a stale exception is not a finding, or a tree without the check is reported as passing.
trigger: A kit tree, a copy with an injected harness-internals import and a foreign board write, a tree where the excepted code is gone, and a tree before the check existed are each run through the check command line.
oracle: REQ-299 criterion AC-2 (violations are refused with code 1 before acceptance, a legal tree passes with 0) and AC-3 (exceptions are named with an owner and a reason, a stale exception is itself a finding); the invariants are I-SEAM-ONLY and I-ONE-WRITER as the requirement states them, driven only through the script's exit code and JSON report.
realism: The boundaries were held only by the orchestrator's memory; the same two reaches that shipped before (a kit module importing a harness package's internals and a second writer of a board state path) are injected into a copy of the tree, and the gate is asked through its public command line.
